label: Taxes & government spending
minus: Raise taxes, especially on high earners and corporations, to fund expanded public programs
plus: Keep taxes low and limit government spending and new programs

label: Housing growth & land use
minus: Preserve local control and neighborhood character; limit density and large new developments
plus: Build much more housing: allow more density, reduce zoning limits, speed up permits

label: Renters & landlords
minus: Stronger renter protections: rent control, eviction limits, tenant legal aid
plus: More flexibility for property owners: fewer rent and eviction rules

label: Policing & criminal justice
minus: Shift resources to prevention and alternatives; reduce incarceration and sentence lengths
plus: Expand police staffing and enforcement; tougher penalties for crime

label: Homelessness response
minus: Housing-first: provide housing and services without preconditions; avoid enforcement-led approaches
plus: Enforcement-led: clear encampments, enforce camping bans, require treatment or shelter acceptance

label: Climate & energy
minus: Aggressive climate action: faster emissions cuts, stricter environmental rules, phase out fossil fuels
plus: Prioritize energy affordability and reliability; fewer environmental mandates, keep oil and gas production

label: Workers & business
minus: Stronger worker protections: higher minimum wages, union power, mandated benefits
plus: Business flexibility: fewer labor mandates and regulations, lower costs for employers

label: Immigration
minus: Protect immigrants: sanctuary policies, limit cooperation with federal immigration enforcement
plus: Cooperate with federal immigration enforcement; stricter immigration policy

label: Education
minus: Invest in traditional public schools; limit charter expansion; support teachers' unions
plus: Expand school choice and charters; greater parental control over curriculum

label: Abortion & LGBTQ+ rights
minus: Protect and expand abortion access and LGBTQ+ legal protections
plus: More restrictions on abortion; emphasis on traditional or religious values

label: Guns
minus: Stricter gun laws: more restrictions on purchase, carry, and types of firearms
plus: Protect gun rights: fewer restrictions on ownership and carry

label: Health care
minus: Government-run or publicly expanded coverage (e.g. single-payer, expanded Medi-Cal)
plus: Market-based health care with private insurance and less government role

label: Transportation
minus: Prioritize transit, bike, and pedestrian infrastructure, even at the cost of car lanes and parking
plus: Prioritize roads, driving, and parking; skeptical of reallocating street space

label: Elections & voting
minus: Make voting easier and expand participation: universal mail ballots, fewer ID requirements, public campaign financing
plus: Tighten election rules: stricter voter ID and verification, fewer mail-ballot accommodations
